mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO tenant_favorite(tenant_id, listing_id, created_at) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{listingId}, #{createdAt})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM tenant_favorite WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND listing_id = #{listingId}
mapper.select: SELECT CAST(l.id AS CHAR) AS id, l.title, l.community_name AS communityName, l.district, l.address, l.rent_cent AS rentCent, l.deposit_cent AS depositCent, u.room_count AS roomCount, u.hall_count AS hallCount, u.bathroom_count AS bathroomCount, u.area_sqm AS areaSqm, u.orientation, l.tags_json AS tagsJson, (SELECT m.url FROM listing_media m WHERE m.listing_id = l.id ORDER BY m.sort_no LIMIT 1) AS coverUrl, 1 AS favorite, l.is_special AS special FROM ${table} r JOIN house_listing l ON l.id = r.listing_id JOIN property_unit u ON u.id = l.unit_id WHERE r.tenant_id = #{tenantId} ORDER BY r.${timeColumn} DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tenant_browse_history(id, tenant_id, listing_id, viewed_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{tenantId}, #{listingId}, #{viewedAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE viewed_at = VALUES(viewed_at)
